judge: naive Opus judge (not the maker), 2026-10-23, round 2 (Modern only)

prior_fix_check.pedestal: RESOLVED. Single round post on a bolted square foot plate in W, N and S, both states; no box base. Matches the 2026-10-15 pick (before art's post-on-plate).
prior_fix_check.handwheel: RESOLVED. North near-hub valve is a spoked handwheel on a chrome body, not a cap.

maker_flags.north_handwheel_faces_viewer: NOT A DEFECT. Measured on Reel_PumpHookup_north.png: wheel is ~0.56 tall for its width, i.e. a horizontal wheel seen through the ~35deg building camera, same treatment as the W and S wheels; the chrome body below it reads as the valve stub projecting toward the camera.
maker_flags.south_pipe_covers_post: NOTE ONLY. The outlet pipe runs in front of the post, which is geometrically correct (near-hub coupling down to the south-edge outlet); the foot plate and post edges still show either side, so the pedestal still reads.

common_findings.C3: All facings drawn from the ~35deg building camera: W shows the drum side over the plate top; N/S show the near flange as a disk with the far flange and drum foreshortened above it.
common_findings.C6: No bore on any ground-lying pipe. Only the S outlet coupling shows a bore, where it points at the camera at the cell edge (same as the passed looks). W gooseneck side-on.
common_findings.C2: W/N/S agree in size, proportions and red/chrome palette in both states; the reel axis and valve end are consistent across facings (valve opposite the intake).
common_findings.hose_meets_outlet: W and S: coupling ends exactly at the hose marker. N: intake hidden; hose starts at the far flange rim, accepted as in round 1.
common_findings.halo_float: None seen; every part inside the footprint and grounded on the plate.

verdicts.notes: Pedestal and handwheel restored; facings agree.
Same frame/pedestal as stored; remaining wraps and chrome core read correctly in N/S.
